summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Iteration-74 Website Media + New User Tutorial Builder. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_website_media.py + /app/backend/tests/test_iter73_updates.py: 19/19 passing (6 website_media + 13 iter73 regression). Frontend (stealth login as @stealth): /admin hub shows 'Website Media' card with STEALTH ONLY badge; /admin/WebsiteMedia loads with all 13 mode rows (neon/cyber/jungle/aquaria/adventure/alien/ancient egypt/business/millennium/retro/social/stealth/terra vetus). Search 'jung' filters to Jungle only (1 row). Upload logo to Jungle -> ImageCropperModal opens (wm-cropper) -> Apply -> DRAFT badge appears + wm-publish-bar shows '1 mode with unsaved draft changes'. Preview modal (wm-nav-preview) opens with draft asset. wm-publish-all + confirm -> Jungle transitions to PUBLISHED v1. wm-rollback-jungle + confirm -> Jungle rolled back to v2 EMPTY. Tutorial Builder: created 2 draft slides (Welcome image + Explore image) via wm-add-slide -> upload -> title/alt-text -> wm-slide-save. Reorder wm-slide-down-0 -> [Explore, Welcome] then wm-slide-up-1 -> [Welcome, Explore]; order persists after page refresh. Duplicate (3 slides) then delete (back to 2). Settings toggle (wm-tutorial-settings-toggle) reveals audience/status/skip/close/progress fields; set audience=all_users. Preview (wm-tutorial-preview) opens tutorial-popup with tutorial-next/prev/dots/close working. Publish flow: wm-tutorial-publish -> wm-publish-modal shows slide counts + everyone checkbox -> wm-publish-confirm -> version incremented, badge=PUBLISHED. Normal user (auditcheckreal) validation: /admin shows 'Admins only' (Website Media card NOT visible), /admin/WebsiteMedia shows wm-forbidden with text 'Only Stealth can modify Website Media.' Tutorial popup auto-appears on /home after ~800ms delay when audience=all_users + show_to_everyone; counter '1 / 2', tutorial-next advances to '2 / 2', tutorial-finish closes. After finish + refresh, popup does NOT reappear (server-side completion tracked). Cleanup: as stealth published a new tutorial version (v11) with status=Published+audience=new_users; direct API check GET /api/tutorial/active as auditcheckreal now returns {"tutorial":null}. Regression: /admin loads, /admin/data-health tab-overview present, header logo (data-testid ourrealm-logo) renders non-broken on /admin, /home. Public GET /api/website-media/published returns full mode config with cyber logo intact (from previous iteration) and jungle rolled back to null v2.
critical_code_review_comments: Because the newly published tutorial has audience=all_users and show_to_everyone=true, /admin/WebsiteMedia mounts the Layout which mounts <TutorialPopup /> globally, so stealth is themselves prompted by the popup after publish. That's expected (all_users includes founder), but from an authoring UX standpoint the Publish confirmation dialog could warn that a founder-visible popup will show if audience=all_users. Not a bug — just a UX consideration.

The AdminHub card badge text is 'Stealth Only' (title case) while the review request phrases it as 'STEALTH ONLY badge' — the actual header inside /admin/WebsiteMedia does show 'STEALTH ONLY ACCESS' in uppercase (line 544 of AdminWebsiteMedia.jsx). Both variants are present; not a bug.
Console still emits net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for a legacy https://example.com/v.mp4 reference (carried over from iteration 73; not related to this iteration).

TutorialPopup mounts only inside Layout — verified. It does not mount on /admin/WebsiteMedia itself (that's a ShellRoute so Layout is present), which is why the popup appeared to stealth on the WM page. Not a functional issue.
seed_data_creation: As stealth: Uploaded Jungle logo draft (crop-applied) -> published v1 -> rolled back to v2 (empty). Created 2 tutorial draft slides (Welcome + Explore) with mode-generated PNGs uploaded via /api/images/upload. Published tutorial v10 (audience=all_users) for the normal-user popup test, then republished v11 (audience=new_users) as cleanup. Final state: tutorial audience=new_users, /api/tutorial/active for auditcheckreal returns null. Jungle logo cleared. The 2 draft slides remain in the draft (not deleted) — they can be safely left as-is because status=published + audience=new_users hides them from all existing users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires clicking [data-testid=landing-signin-button] first to reveal signin-email/signin-password/signin-submit fields — this is different from a direct /login form. If a session cookie exists, /login shows a 'CONTINUE AS @<username>' interstitial with SIGN OUT + BROWSE AS GUEST — always page.context.clear_cookies() before switching users. TutorialPopup only mounts inside <Layout> (ShellRoute pages: /home, /admin/*, /realms, etc). If a normal-user popup test doesn't fire, clear localStorage['ourrealm.tutorial.done.v'] then reload — the popup is server-eligibility-driven with a small localStorage perf hint. Tutorial audience=all_users + show_to_everyone=true causes the popup to also render on /admin/WebsiteMedia for the founder — dismiss it before touching wm-tutorial-status / wm-tutorial-audience selects. Wm mode search filters by mode_name (substring, case-insensitive). Wm cropper testid is 'wm-cropper' with sub-ids 'wm-cropper-apply' / 'wm-cropper-cancel'. Confirm dialogs are native window.confirm — use page.on('dialog', accept). Delete-draft prompt requires typing 'DELETE DRAFT' — use dialog.accept('DELETE DRAFT').
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 7 review-request scenarios pass. Website Media MVP + New User Tutorial Builder work end-to-end with proper founder gating (401/403 for non-founders + client-side wm-forbidden), draft/publish/rollback flows, server-side tutorial audience + completion tracking, and correct fallback chain on the header logo.
